indicators.label: 20-bar high broken
indicators.text: The close is above the highest high of the 20 bars before.

indicators.label: Close above the upper Bollinger band
indicators.text: A push beyond two standard deviations.

indicators.label: Price above SMA 50
indicators.text: The last close is above the simple 50-bar average.

indicators.label: Aroon up over 70
indicators.text: The high of the last 25 bars is recent and the low is old.

indicators.label: Above yesterday's busiest price
indicators.text: Price is over yesterday's point of control, the price it spent most time at.

indicators.label: RSI (14) between 50 and 70
indicators.text: Strong but not stretched.

indicators.label: Chaikin money flow above 0
indicators.text: Bars close nearer their highs on volume.

indicators.label: Bollinger %B between 0.5 and 1
indicators.text: In the upper half of the bands but not beyond the upper band.

indicators.label: Market is trending (choppiness under 50)
indicators.text: The choppiness index over 14 bars is under 50: price is travelling, not wandering. No direction by itself.

indicators.label: Aroon up above Aroon down
indicators.text: The latest high is newer than the latest low.

indicators.label: CCI (20) above 100
indicators.text: Unusually strong.

indicators.label: Price below max pain
indicators.text: Max pain is the strike where option buyers lose the most at expiry; price is under it, so the pull, if any, is upward. For a put: price above it.

indicators.label: MACD above its signal and above zero
indicators.text: Momentum is up on both counts: the line leads its signal and the 12 EMA is over the 26 EMA.

indicators.label: Price above EMA 50
indicators.text: The last close is above its 50-bar average.

indicators.label: 55-bar high broken (about 4.5 hours)
indicators.text: The close beats the highest high of the 55 bars before: the turtle-style breakout.

indicators.label: Higher low formed
indicators.text: The last bar low is above the low of the 5 bars before.

indicators.label: Fresh OI backs this side (15 min)
indicators.text: In the last 3 bars more put OI than call OI was added. For a put: more call OI.

indicators.label: Breadth improving
indicators.text: The share of stocks on this side is 5 points higher than 3 bars ago.

indicators.label: Close above the upper Keltner channel
indicators.text: A push beyond 1.5 ATR over the 20 EMA.

indicators.label: Parabolic SAR below price
indicators.text: The trailing dot sits under the price.

indicators.label: ADX rising (trend getting stronger)
indicators.text: ADX is over 18 and higher than 3 bars ago, with buyers leading: a trend is building, not fading.

indicators.label: Williams %R crosses up through -80
indicators.text: Leaves the oversold zone.

indicators.label: Bullish engulfing
indicators.text: A bullish body that covers the previous bearish one.

indicators.label: Price 0.5 ATR or more above VWAP
indicators.text: Clear of the day average: the move has room, though it may be stretched.

indicators.label: Above yesterday's value area
indicators.text: Price is over the top of where yesterday spent 70% of its time (market profile, by time at price): buyers accept higher prices.

indicators.label: ATR above its 50-bar average
indicators.text: Bars are bigger than usual: the market is moving. No direction by itself.

indicators.label: Above the day's open
indicators.text: Price is above where the day opened.

indicators.label: OI change backs this side
indicators.text: Since the open, more put OI than call OI has been added near the money (writers expect support). For a put: more call OI added.

indicators.label: CCI (20) above 0
indicators.text: Price is over its typical level.

indicators.label: IV rising
indicators.text: At-the-money implied volatility is higher than 3 bars ago: premiums are getting dearer, which helps a buyer. No direction by itself.

indicators.label: Heikin-Ashi: two strong green bars
indicators.text: The last two Heikin-Ashi candles are green with no lower wick: a smooth push up.

indicators.label: Full-bodied bullish bar
indicators.text: A bullish bar with almost no wicks (body over 80% of the range).

indicators.label: Squeeze fires up (Bollinger leaves Keltner)
indicators.text: The Bollinger bands were inside the Keltner channel (a coiled market) and have just opened with price above the middle.

indicators.label: Price above EMA 20
indicators.text: The last close is above its 20-bar average.

indicators.label: ADX over 30 and +DI over -DI
indicators.text: A strong trend that buyers lead.

indicators.label: Close above the previous high
indicators.text: The bar closes over the previous bar high.

indicators.label: ATR expanding
indicators.text: Ranges are 10% wider than 10 bars ago: the market is waking up. No direction by itself.

indicators.label: Nifty 50 breadth 70%+
indicators.text: At least 70% of the 50 stocks agree.

indicators.label: PCR rising
indicators.text: The PCR is higher than 3 bars ago (15 minutes): put writing is growing. For a put: PCR falling.

indicators.label: Narrow bar, then a wide bullish bar
indicators.text: The previous bar was the narrowest of the last 7, and this bar is wider and closes up over its high: quiet turns to movement.

indicators.label: Above the 2-day anchored VWAP
indicators.text: Price is over the VWAP anchored at yesterday's open: buyers of the last two days are in profit.

indicators.label: Price above SMA 20
indicators.text: The last close is above the simple 20-bar average.

indicators.label: Price above the Bollinger middle
indicators.text: Over the 20-bar average, inside the bands.

indicators.label: Price crosses up through the Bollinger middle
indicators.text: A fresh move over the average.

indicators.label: MACD above its signal line
indicators.text: MACD line over its 9-bar average.

indicators.label: MACD crosses above its signal
indicators.text: A fresh upward cross.

indicators.label: Stochastic %K above 50
indicators.text: Price is in the upper half of its 14-bar range.

indicators.label: Big bullish bar
indicators.text: A bar of 1.2 ATR or more that closes in its top third.

indicators.label: IV percentile under 30 (cheap options)
indicators.text: The at-the-money implied volatility is lower than 70% of the readings of the last 20 saved days: premiums are cheap to buy. No direction by itself.

indicators.label: Williams %R above -50
indicators.text: Price is in the upper half of its 14-bar range.

indicators.label: Gap-and-go bar
indicators.text: A bar opening over the previous high and closing higher.

indicators.label: Price above the Ichimoku cloud
indicators.text: Price is above both cloud edges.

indicators.label: Breakout of the last hour
indicators.text: A 5-minute bar closes above the highest high of the last hour (12 bars). Stop under the lowest low of the last 6 bars.

indicators.label: Pushed 1.5 ATR in 6 bars
indicators.text: A fast move up.

indicators.label: ADX over 25 and rising, buyers lead
indicators.text: A strong trend that is still getting stronger, with +DI over -DI.

indicators.label: Closes in the top third
indicators.text: Buyers won the bar.

indicators.label: Awesome oscillator above 0
indicators.text: 5-bar midpoint average over the 34-bar one.

indicators.label: Price above max pain
indicators.text: Price has already moved past max pain in this direction. For a put: price below it.

indicators.label: Stochastic turns up from below 20
indicators.text: %K crosses over %D while still under 20.

indicators.label: Opening range breakout (30 min)
indicators.text: The first close beyond the 09:15-09:45 range after 09:45, a wider and slower cousin of the 15-minute range. Stop at the other end of the range.

indicators.label: RSI (14) above 50
indicators.text: Buying pressure leads.

indicators.label: RSI crosses up through 50
indicators.text: Momentum turns up.

indicators.label: VWAP pullback in a trend
indicators.text: The index has held above a rising VWAP (8 of the last 12 bars), dips to touch it and closes above the previous bar high. Stop under the dip.

indicators.label: Three higher closes in a row
indicators.text: Steady buying.

indicators.label: EMA 9 above EMA 21
indicators.text: The 9-bar average is above the 21-bar average: the short trend is up.

indicators.label: Above the day's average price
indicators.text: Price is above the average close of today so far.

indicators.label: Force index above 0
indicators.text: Price change times volume is positive.

indicators.label: RSI (14) above 60
indicators.text: Clear buying pressure, a step stronger than above 50.

indicators.label: Bollinger squeeze, then a close above the upper band
indicators.text: The bands were the narrowest of the last 50 bars within the last 6 bars, and price now closes over the upper band.

indicators.label: Morning (09:30 to 11:30)
indicators.text: The most active hours.

indicators.label: First hour after the open (09:30 to 10:30)
indicators.text: The hour most big one-way days are decided.

indicators.label: Price above VWAP
indicators.text: Over the volume-weighted average of the day: buyers hold the day.

indicators.label: EMA 5 above EMA 13
indicators.text: A quick pair of averages: the very short trend is up.

indicators.label: Price over VWAP + 1 standard deviation
indicators.text: Holding over the first VWAP band: a trend day reading.

indicators.label: Hammer
indicators.text: A long lower wick (twice the body, over half the range) and a close in the top third.

indicators.label: Delta 0.5 or more
indicators.text: The strike bought is already a little in the money for this side, so the premium follows the index more closely.

indicators.label: Supertrend (10, 3) up
indicators.text: The supertrend line is below price.

indicators.label: Price crosses up through VWAP
indicators.text: A fresh move over the day average price.

indicators.label: Price above today's pivot
indicators.text: The close is over the floor pivot, (yesterday's high + low + close) / 3: the day leans to buyers.

indicators.label: Price above the CPR
indicators.text: The close is over the whole central pivot range (the pivot and the middle of yesterday's high and low).

indicators.label: Near the day's high
indicators.text: Within 0.3 ATR of the day's high.

indicators.label: RSI (7) above 55
indicators.text: A quicker RSI shows buying pressure.

indicators.label: Price above EMA 200
indicators.text: Above the long-run average (about 2.5 sessions of 5-minute bars).

indicators.label: 15-minute trend up
indicators.text: The 15-minute averages (EMA 27 over EMA 63 on 5-minute bars) agree: the bigger picture is up, so a pullback is a gift and not a warning.

indicators.label: Supertrend (14, 3) up
indicators.text: A slower supertrend is below price: fewer flips on a choppy day.

indicators.label: Nifty 50 breadth 80%+
indicators.text: At least 80% of the 50 stocks agree: a one-way day.

indicators.label: RSI (14) under 75
indicators.text: Not yet overbought: some room left. For a put, RSI over 25.

indicators.label: MACD histogram positive and rising
indicators.text: Momentum is up and growing.

indicators.label: Room left in the day (range under 80% of usual)
indicators.text: Today's range so far is under 80% of the average of the last 5 days: the move is not used up yet. No direction by itself.

indicators.label: Money flow index above 50
indicators.text: Volume-weighted RSI shows more buying than selling.

indicators.label: Money flow index crosses up through 50
indicators.text: The volume-weighted RSI turns to buying.

indicators.label: Nifty 50 breadth
indicators.text: At least 70% of the 50 stocks are above (call) or below (put) yesterday close and the index is on the same side of its day average. Stop under the last 6 bars.

indicators.label: CCI crosses up through -100
indicators.text: Bounce from an oversold reading.

indicators.label: EMA 21 rising
indicators.text: The 21-bar average is higher than 3 bars ago.

indicators.label: EMA 9 > 21 > 50 lined up
indicators.text: All three averages are lined up upward: a clean trend.

indicators.label: EMA 9 / 21 cross
indicators.text: The 9 EMA crosses above the 21 EMA with price above both. Stop under the last 6 bars.

indicators.label: Inside the Camarilla H3 to L3
indicators.text: Price is between H3 and L3: a balanced, range-bound reading. No direction by itself.

indicators.label: Engulfing candle at a low / high
indicators.text: After a few falling bars near the 20-bar low, a bullish candle whose body covers the previous bearish one. Stop under both.

indicators.label: Breadth crosses to the majority
indicators.text: More than half of the 50 stocks switch to this side.

indicators.label: Pullback to the pivot that holds
indicators.text: Price dipped to within 0.3 ATR of the pivot (or the CPR top) in the last 3 bars and a bullish bar closes back over it.

indicators.label: Rising straight-line trend (20 bars)
indicators.text: The best-fit line through 20 bars slopes up and fits well (R squared over 0.6).

indicators.label: Vortex +VI above -VI
indicators.text: Upward vortex movement dominates.

indicators.label: Ultimate oscillator above 50
indicators.text: Momentum over three time frames is positive.

indicators.label: CPR breakout
indicators.text: The first close of the day above the central pivot range (yesterday's pivot and the mid of its high and low), on a day that opened under it. Traders watch it most on a narrow-CPR day. Stop under the last 6 bars.

indicators.label: First close above R1 today
indicators.text: Price breaks the first resistance, 2 x pivot - yesterday's low: a strong day.

indicators.label: Sharp fall, then turn
indicators.text: A fall of 4 ATR or more, then price turns off the low: a higher low and a bar that closes above the previous bar high, within 2 ATR of the low. Stop under the low.

indicators.label: Bar closes up
indicators.text: The close is above the open.

indicators.label: Gapped up at the open (0.3%+)
indicators.text: The day opened at least 0.3% over yesterday close.

indicators.label: TRIX above zero
indicators.text: The triple-smoothed rate of change is positive.

indicators.label: Midday (11:30 to 13:30)
indicators.text: The usual lull: moves are smaller and break less often.

indicators.label: Nifty 50 breadth 60%+
indicators.text: At least 60% of the 50 stocks are above yesterday close (for a put: below).

indicators.label: ADX over 25 (strong trend)
indicators.text: A strong trend is under way, either way. It does not pick a direction, so pair it with another check.

indicators.label: MACD above zero
indicators.text: The 12 EMA is over the 26 EMA.

indicators.label: Inside bar breakout
indicators.text: A big bar (1.2 ATR or more), a small bar inside it, then a close beyond the big bar. Stop at the big bar other end.

indicators.label: Higher highs and higher lows
indicators.text: The last 3 bars have a higher high and a higher low than the 3 before.

indicators.label: Yesterday's high / low break
indicators.text: The first 5-minute close of the day beyond the previous day's high (call) or low (put), after 09:30. Stop under the last 6 bars.

indicators.label: EMA 50 rising
indicators.text: The 50-bar average is higher than 5 bars ago.

indicators.label: Awesome oscillator turns up
indicators.text: It rises after two falling bars.

indicators.label: Three advancing bars
indicators.text: Three bullish bars, each closing higher with a real body.

indicators.label: Price above R1
indicators.text: Trading over the first floor resistance.

indicators.label: Above yesterday's close
indicators.text: The day is up.

indicators.label: First close above the CPR today
indicators.text: Price opened at or under the CPR and has just closed over it for the first time today.

indicators.label: Ichimoku fast line above slow line
indicators.text: The 9-bar midpoint is above the 26-bar midpoint.

indicators.label: Delta 0.4 to 0.6
indicators.text: The at-the-money option of this side moves about half as much as the index: it is near the money, not a lottery ticket.

indicators.label: After 10:00
indicators.text: Skips the opening noise.

indicators.label: Theta under 8% a day
indicators.text: A day of waiting costs the at-the-money option less than 8% of its premium. Avoids the last days before expiry, when time eats the premium fast. No direction by itself.

indicators.label: EMA 21 above EMA 50
indicators.text: The medium trend is up.

indicators.label: Price up over 10 bars
indicators.text: The close is above the close 10 bars ago.

indicators.label: MACD histogram turns up
indicators.text: The histogram stops falling and rises while it is still below zero.

indicators.label: Supertrend flip
indicators.text: The supertrend (10, 3) turns from down to up. Stop at the supertrend line.

indicators.label: Back inside from under VWAP - 2 standard deviations
indicators.text: Price was under the lower 2-deviation band and closes back over it: a stretched fall snapping back.

indicators.label: +DI above -DI
indicators.text: Upward movement is stronger than downward movement.

indicators.label: Theta under 5% a day
indicators.text: A day of waiting costs less than 5% of the premium: a contract with plenty of time left. No direction by itself.

indicators.label: Narrow CPR day
indicators.text: Today's CPR is under 60% of its average width over the last 5 days. Indian traders read a narrow CPR as a likely trending day. No direction by itself.

indicators.label: Opened inside yesterday's range
indicators.text: Today opened between yesterday's high and low: no gap, so levels matter more. No direction by itself.

indicators.label: Chaikin money flow above 0.1
indicators.text: Clear accumulation.

indicators.label: Today's CPR above yesterday's
indicators.text: The whole of today's CPR sits over yesterday's: value is moving up (an ascending CPR).

indicators.label: Camarilla H4 / L4 breakout
indicators.text: The first close of the day beyond the Camarilla H4 (call) or L4 (put), yesterday's close plus half of its range times 1.1: often the start of a trend day. Stop under H3 or the last 6 bars, whichever is nearer.

indicators.label: Breaks the Camarilla H4
indicators.text: First close of the day over H4 (yesterday's close + 1.1 x range / 2): Camarilla traders treat it as a breakout and a possible trend day.

indicators.label: VWAP rising
indicators.text: The day average is higher than 3 bars ago.

indicators.label: Stochastic %K above %D
indicators.text: The fast line is over the slow line.

indicators.label: +DI crosses over -DI (ADX over 20)
indicators.text: Buyers take over the directional movement while a trend exists.

indicators.label: Strong momentum bar
indicators.text: A big bar (1.5 ATR or more) that closes in its top 15% and above the highest high of the last 6 bars. Stop under the bar.

indicators.label: RSI (14) rising
indicators.text: RSI is higher than 3 bars ago.

indicators.label: Double bottom / top
indicators.text: Price makes the same low twice, with a bounce of at least 1.5 ATR between them, then closes above the bounce high. Stop under the two lows.

indicators.label: Double bottom / top, tighter stop
indicators.text: The same double bottom, but the stop sits half way between the lows and the neckline, so it fits the loss limit. It gives up the room under the lows.

indicators.label: ADX over 20 and +DI over -DI
indicators.text: A trend exists (ADX over 20) and buyers lead it.

indicators.label: Breakout on high volume
indicators.text: The breakout of the last hour, on at least 1.5 times the usual volume (traded value of the 50 stocks). Stop under the last 6 bars.

indicators.label: Reclaims the Camarilla L3
indicators.text: On a day that opened inside H3 and L3, price closes back over L3 after being under it: the range-day fade.

indicators.label: Camarilla L3 / H3 reversal
indicators.text: On a day that opened inside H3 and L3, price dips under L3 and a bullish bar closes back over it (for a put: pokes over H3 and closes back under). A range-day fade. Stop under the last 6 bars.

indicators.label: Volume climax at a low / high
indicators.text: A bar at the 20-bar low on 2.5 times the usual volume that closes in its top half: sellers look exhausted. Stop under the bar.

indicators.label: Supertrend (7, 2) up
indicators.text: A quicker supertrend is below price.

indicators.label: VWAP reclaim / rejection
indicators.text: Price closed under the volume-weighted average for 3 bars, then closes back above it on 1.2 times the usual volume. Stop under the last 6 bars. The index has no volume of its own, so VWAP and volume are built from the traded value of the 50 stocks.

indicators.label: Wide CPR day
indicators.text: Today's CPR is over 1.5 times its 5-day average width: usually a sideways day, better for fades than breakouts. No direction by itself.

indicators.label: Above VWAP but within 0.5 ATR of it
indicators.text: Over the day average and not stretched away from it: a calmer entry than a chase.

indicators.label: Bounce off the lower Bollinger band
indicators.text: Price dipped under the lower band and closed back over it.

indicators.label: Volume 2.5 times the usual
indicators.text: A surge in traded value. No direction by itself.

indicators.label: IV percentile under 60
indicators.text: Implied volatility is not high against the last 20 saved days, so a calm-down after the buy costs less. No direction by itself.

indicators.label: RSI (2) under 10
indicators.text: A very short-term oversold reading. On its own it fights the move; pair it with a trend check.

indicators.label: Opening range breakout
indicators.text: The first close beyond the 09:15-09:30 range after 09:30. Stop at the other end of that range.

indicators.label: Back into value from below (80% rule)
indicators.text: The day opened under yesterday's value area and has now closed inside it twice in a row: price often crosses the whole area.

indicators.label: RSI crosses up through 30
indicators.text: The oversold bounce.

indicators.label: PCR above 1.2
indicators.text: Clearly more puts than calls written near the money. For a put: PCR under 0.83.

indicators.label: Back into value (80% rule)
indicators.text: The day opened under yesterday's value area (where it spent 70% of its time) and then closes back inside it twice in a row: price often travels across the whole area. Stop under the last 6 bars.

indicators.label: OBV above its 20-bar average
indicators.text: On-balance volume trends up.

indicators.label: Breaks yesterday's high
indicators.text: The close crosses over the whole of yesterday for the first time today.

indicators.label: Volume 1.5 times the usual
indicators.text: Traded value is 1.5 times the average of the last 20 bars. No direction by itself.

indicators.label: Pullback in a trend
indicators.text: The 9, 21 and 50 EMAs are lined up, price dips to the 21 EMA and then closes above the previous bar high. Stop under the dip.

indicators.label: Quiet bars, then a break on volume
indicators.text: Three bars on below-average volume, then a close over the 6-bar high on 1.5 times the usual volume: a coil that opens with money behind it.

indicators.label: Above yesterday's high
indicators.text: Price is trading over the whole of yesterday.

indicators.label: Heavy buying bar
indicators.text: A bullish bar on 1.5 times the usual volume.

indicators.label: Hammer / shooting star
indicators.text: A candle near the 20-bar low with a long lower wick (twice its body, over half the range) that closes in its top third. Stop under the wick.

indicators.label: Open drive (strong first half hour)
indicators.text: After 09:30 price is at least 2 ATR over the open and never fell more than half an ATR under it: buyers took the day from the first bar.

indicators.label: Not midday (skips 11:30 to 13:30)
indicators.text: Real-price tests found the midday lull wins least often. Use it as a filter beside an entry check.

indicators.label: Above the opening range
indicators.text: Price is above the high of the first 15 minutes (after 09:30).

indicators.label: Breaks the opening range (first 15 minutes)
indicators.text: The close crosses over the high of the first three bars for the first time.

indicators.label: ATR not wild (under 1.5 times its 50-bar average)
indicators.text: Bars are not unusually big: stops are less likely to be hit by noise. No direction by itself.

indicators.label: Afternoon (13:30 to 15:00)
indicators.text: Positions are built for the close.

indicators.label: Bollinger squeeze (tight bands)
indicators.text: The bands are as narrow as at any time in the last 50 bars: a big move is brewing, either way.

indicators.label: Heikin-Ashi turns green
indicators.text: The first green Heikin-Ashi candle after two red ones.

indicators.label: Price above Hull average 21
indicators.text: The Hull average reacts faster than the others; price is above it.

indicators.label: RSI (2) dip bought in an uptrend
indicators.text: Connors style: the 2-bar RSI was under 10 and turns back over it while price is over the 50 EMA. A short dip in a rising market.

indicators.label: Pullback to VWAP that holds
indicators.text: Price dipped to within 0.3 ATR of VWAP in the last 3 bars, closed back above it, and VWAP is rising: buyers defend the day average.

indicators.label: EMA 9 rising
indicators.text: The 9-bar average is higher than 2 bars ago.

indicators.label: Pullback on fading volume
indicators.text: Price is lower than 3 bars ago but volume is under average: sellers are not pushing.

indicators.label: PCR above 1 (more puts written)
indicators.text: Put open interest is larger than call open interest near the money: option sellers are backing a floor. For a put: PCR under 1.

indicators.label: Today's CPR above yesterday's
indicators.text: The whole of today's CPR sits over yesterday's: value is moving up (an ascending CPR).

indicators.label: Room left in the day (range under 80% of usual)
indicators.text: Today's range so far is under 80% of the average of the last 5 days: the move is not used up yet. No direction by itself.

indicators.label: Narrow CPR day
indicators.text: Today's CPR is under 60% of its average width over the last 5 days. Indian traders read a narrow CPR as a likely trending day. No direction by itself.

indicators.label: Wide CPR day
indicators.text: Today's CPR is over 1.5 times its 5-day average width: usually a sideways day, better for fades than breakouts. No direction by itself.

indicators.label: Opened inside yesterday's range
indicators.text: Today opened between yesterday's high and low: no gap, so levels matter more. No direction by itself.

indicators.label: Gapped up at the open (0.3%+)
indicators.text: The day opened at least 0.3% over yesterday close.

indicators.label: Back into value (80% rule)
indicators.text: The day opened under yesterday's value area (where it spent 70% of its time) and then closes back inside it twice in a row: price often travels across the whole area. Stop under the last 6 bars.

indicators.label: Opening range breakout (30 min)
indicators.text: The first close beyond the 09:15-09:45 range after 09:45, a wider and slower cousin of the 15-minute range. Stop at the other end of the range.

indicators.label: Open drive (strong first half hour)
indicators.text: After 09:30 price is at least 2 ATR over the open and never fell more than half an ATR under it: buyers took the day from the first bar.

indicators.label: Back into value from below (80% rule)
indicators.text: The day opened under yesterday's value area and has now closed inside it twice in a row: price often crosses the whole area.

indicators.label: CPR breakout
indicators.text: The first close of the day above the central pivot range (yesterday's pivot and the mid of its high and low), on a day that opened under it. Traders watch it most on a narrow-CPR day. Stop under the last 6 bars.

indicators.label: First close above the CPR today
indicators.text: Price opened at or under the CPR and has just closed over it for the first time today.

indicators.label: Nifty 50 breadth
indicators.text: At least 70% of the 50 stocks are above (call) or below (put) yesterday close and the index is on the same side of its day average. Stop under the last 6 bars.

indicators.label: Gap-and-go bar
indicators.text: A bar opening over the previous high and closing higher.

indicators.label: Opening range breakout
indicators.text: The first close beyond the 09:15-09:30 range after 09:30. Stop at the other end of that range.

indicators.label: Yesterday's high / low break
indicators.text: The first 5-minute close of the day beyond the previous day's high (call) or low (put), after 09:30. Stop under the last 6 bars.

indicators.label: First close above R1 today
indicators.text: Price breaks the first resistance, 2 x pivot - yesterday's low: a strong day.

indicators.label: Breaks the Camarilla H4
indicators.text: First close of the day over H4 (yesterday's close + 1.1 x range / 2): Camarilla traders treat it as a breakout and a possible trend day.

indicators.label: Camarilla H4 / L4 breakout
indicators.text: The first close of the day beyond the Camarilla H4 (call) or L4 (put), yesterday's close plus half of its range times 1.1: often the start of a trend day. Stop under H3 or the last 6 bars, whichever is nearer.

indicators.label: Camarilla L3 / H3 reversal
indicators.text: On a day that opened inside H3 and L3, price dips under L3 and a bullish bar closes back over it (for a put: pokes over H3 and closes back under). A range-day fade. Stop under the last 6 bars.

indicators.label: Double bottom / top
indicators.text: Price makes the same low twice, with a bounce of at least 1.5 ATR between them, then closes above the bounce high. Stop under the two lows.

indicators.label: Double bottom / top, tighter stop
indicators.text: The same double bottom, but the stop sits half way between the lows and the neckline, so it fits the loss limit. It gives up the room under the lows.

indicators.label: Nifty 50 breadth 80%+
indicators.text: At least 80% of the 50 stocks agree: a one-way day.

indicators.label: Reclaims the Camarilla L3
indicators.text: On a day that opened inside H3 and L3, price closes back over L3 after being under it: the range-day fade.

indicators.label: Three advancing bars
indicators.text: Three bullish bars, each closing higher with a real body.

indicators.label: VWAP reclaim / rejection
indicators.text: Price closed under the volume-weighted average for 3 bars, then closes back above it on 1.2 times the usual volume. Stop under the last 6 bars. The index has no volume of its own, so VWAP and volume are built from the traded value of the 50 stocks.

indicators.label: RSI (14) under 75
indicators.text: Not yet overbought: some room left. For a put, RSI over 25.

indicators.label: Price above R1
indicators.text: Trading over the first floor resistance.

indicators.label: Inside bar breakout
indicators.text: A big bar (1.2 ATR or more), a small bar inside it, then a close beyond the big bar. Stop at the big bar other end.

indicators.label: Quiet bars, then a break on volume
indicators.text: Three bars on below-average volume, then a close over the 6-bar high on 1.5 times the usual volume: a coil that opens with money behind it.

indicators.label: Price above the CPR
indicators.text: The close is over the whole central pivot range (the pivot and the middle of yesterday's high and low).

indicators.label: EMA 21 above EMA 50
indicators.text: The medium trend is up.

indicators.label: Above yesterday's value area
indicators.text: Price is over the top of where yesterday spent 70% of its time (market profile, by time at price): buyers accept higher prices.

indicators.label: Volume climax at a low / high
indicators.text: A bar at the 20-bar low on 2.5 times the usual volume that closes in its top half: sellers look exhausted. Stop under the bar.

indicators.label: Above yesterday's busiest price
indicators.text: Price is over yesterday's point of control, the price it spent most time at.

indicators.label: Price above EMA 200
indicators.text: Above the long-run average (about 2.5 sessions of 5-minute bars).

indicators.label: Breaks yesterday's high
indicators.text: The close crosses over the whole of yesterday for the first time today.

indicators.label: Above yesterday's high
indicators.text: Price is trading over the whole of yesterday.

indicators.label: Pullback to the pivot that holds
indicators.text: Price dipped to within 0.3 ATR of the pivot (or the CPR top) in the last 3 bars and a bullish bar closes back over it.

indicators.label: Price above today's pivot
indicators.text: The close is over the floor pivot, (yesterday's high + low + close) / 3: the day leans to buyers.

indicators.label: Nifty 50 breadth 70%+
indicators.text: At least 70% of the 50 stocks agree.

indicators.label: Supertrend flip
indicators.text: The supertrend (10, 3) turns from down to up. Stop at the supertrend line.

indicators.label: Supertrend (14, 3) up
indicators.text: A slower supertrend is below price: fewer flips on a choppy day.

indicators.label: Strong momentum bar
indicators.text: A big bar (1.5 ATR or more) that closes in its top 15% and above the highest high of the last 6 bars. Stop under the bar.

indicators.label: Supertrend (10, 3) up
indicators.text: The supertrend line is below price.

indicators.label: Nifty 50 breadth 60%+
indicators.text: At least 60% of the 50 stocks are above yesterday close (for a put: below).

indicators.label: Above yesterday's close
indicators.text: The day is up.

indicators.label: TRIX above zero
indicators.text: The triple-smoothed rate of change is positive.

indicators.label: Bollinger squeeze, then a close above the upper band
indicators.text: The bands were the narrowest of the last 50 bars within the last 6 bars, and price now closes over the upper band.

indicators.label: ATR not wild (under 1.5 times its 50-bar average)
indicators.text: Bars are not unusually big: stops are less likely to be hit by noise. No direction by itself.

indicators.label: Near the day's high
indicators.text: Within 0.3 ATR of the day's high.

indicators.label: Above the opening range
indicators.text: Price is above the high of the first 15 minutes (after 09:30).

indicators.label: Breaks the opening range (first 15 minutes)
indicators.text: The close crosses over the high of the first three bars for the first time.

indicators.label: ADX over 25 and rising, buyers lead
indicators.text: A strong trend that is still getting stronger, with +DI over -DI.

indicators.label: Breadth crosses to the majority
indicators.text: More than half of the 50 stocks switch to this side.

indicators.label: 55-bar high broken (about 4.5 hours)
indicators.text: The close beats the highest high of the 55 bars before: the turtle-style breakout.

indicators.label: ATR above its 50-bar average
indicators.text: Bars are bigger than usual: the market is moving. No direction by itself.

indicators.label: Engulfing candle at a low / high
indicators.text: After a few falling bars near the 20-bar low, a bullish candle whose body covers the previous bearish one. Stop under both.

indicators.label: Squeeze fires up (Bollinger leaves Keltner)
indicators.text: The Bollinger bands were inside the Keltner channel (a coiled market) and have just opened with price above the middle.

indicators.label: EMA 9 > 21 > 50 lined up
indicators.text: All three averages are lined up upward: a clean trend.

indicators.label: Above the 2-day anchored VWAP
indicators.text: Price is over the VWAP anchored at yesterday's open: buyers of the last two days are in profit.

indicators.label: ADX over 30 and +DI over -DI
indicators.text: A strong trend that buyers lead.

indicators.label: Breakout on high volume
indicators.text: The breakout of the last hour, on at least 1.5 times the usual volume (traded value of the 50 stocks). Stop under the last 6 bars.

indicators.label: Above the day's open
indicators.text: Price is above where the day opened.

indicators.label: 15-minute trend up
indicators.text: The 15-minute averages (EMA 27 over EMA 63 on 5-minute bars) agree: the bigger picture is up, so a pullback is a gift and not a warning.

indicators.label: Hammer / shooting star
indicators.text: A candle near the 20-bar low with a long lower wick (twice its body, over half the range) that closes in its top third. Stop under the wick.

indicators.label: VWAP pullback in a trend
indicators.text: The index has held above a rising VWAP (8 of the last 12 bars), dips to touch it and closes above the previous bar high. Stop under the dip.

indicators.label: Pullback in a trend
indicators.text: The 9, 21 and 50 EMAs are lined up, price dips to the 21 EMA and then closes above the previous bar high. Stop under the dip.

indicators.label: RSI crosses up through 30
indicators.text: The oversold bounce.

indicators.label: Sharp fall, then turn
indicators.text: A fall of 4 ATR or more, then price turns off the low: a higher low and a bar that closes above the previous bar high, within 2 ATR of the low. Stop under the low.

indicators.label: EMA 50 rising
indicators.text: The 50-bar average is higher than 5 bars ago.

indicators.label: RSI (2) dip bought in an uptrend
indicators.text: Connors style: the 2-bar RSI was under 10 and turns back over it while price is over the 50 EMA. A short dip in a rising market.

indicators.label: MACD above zero
indicators.text: The 12 EMA is over the 26 EMA.

indicators.label: ADX rising (trend getting stronger)
indicators.text: ADX is over 18 and higher than 3 bars ago, with buyers leading: a trend is building, not fading.

indicators.label: Price above the Ichimoku cloud
indicators.text: Price is above both cloud edges.

indicators.label: ADX over 25 (strong trend)
indicators.text: A strong trend is under way, either way. It does not pick a direction, so pair it with another check.

indicators.label: ATR expanding
indicators.text: Ranges are 10% wider than 10 bars ago: the market is waking up. No direction by itself.

indicators.label: Morning (09:30 to 11:30)
indicators.text: The most active hours.

indicators.label: First hour after the open (09:30 to 10:30)
indicators.text: The hour most big one-way days are decided.

indicators.label: +DI crosses over -DI (ADX over 20)
indicators.text: Buyers take over the directional movement while a trend exists.

indicators.label: Inside the Camarilla H3 to L3
indicators.text: Price is between H3 and L3: a balanced, range-bound reading. No direction by itself.

indicators.label: Close above the upper Bollinger band
indicators.text: A push beyond two standard deviations.

indicators.label: 20-bar high broken
indicators.text: The close is above the highest high of the 20 bars before.

indicators.label: Rising straight-line trend (20 bars)
indicators.text: The best-fit line through 20 bars slopes up and fits well (R squared over 0.6).

indicators.label: EMA 9 / 21 cross
indicators.text: The 9 EMA crosses above the 21 EMA with price above both. Stop under the last 6 bars.

indicators.label: EMA 9 above EMA 21
indicators.text: The 9-bar average is above the 21-bar average: the short trend is up.

indicators.label: Close above the upper Keltner channel
indicators.text: A push beyond 1.5 ATR over the 20 EMA.

indicators.label: Aroon up over 70
indicators.text: The high of the last 25 bars is recent and the low is old.

indicators.label: RSI (14) above 60
indicators.text: Clear buying pressure, a step stronger than above 50.

indicators.label: Price above SMA 50
indicators.text: The last close is above the simple 50-bar average.

indicators.label: MACD above its signal and above zero
indicators.text: Momentum is up on both counts: the line leads its signal and the 12 EMA is over the 26 EMA.

indicators.label: ADX over 20 and +DI over -DI
indicators.text: A trend exists (ADX over 20) and buyers lead it.

indicators.label: Price above EMA 50
indicators.text: The last close is above its 50-bar average.

indicators.label: Breakout of the last hour
indicators.text: A 5-minute bar closes above the highest high of the last hour (12 bars). Stop under the lowest low of the last 6 bars.

indicators.label: CCI (20) above 100
indicators.text: Unusually strong.

indicators.label: Back inside from under VWAP - 2 standard deviations
indicators.text: Price was under the lower 2-deviation band and closes back over it: a stretched fall snapping back.

indicators.label: Aroon up above Aroon down
indicators.text: The latest high is newer than the latest low.

indicators.label: Awesome oscillator above 0
indicators.text: 5-bar midpoint average over the 34-bar one.

indicators.label: Supertrend (7, 2) up
indicators.text: A quicker supertrend is below price.

indicators.label: Bollinger squeeze (tight bands)
indicators.text: The bands are as narrow as at any time in the last 50 bars: a big move is brewing, either way.

indicators.label: VWAP rising
indicators.text: The day average is higher than 3 bars ago.

indicators.label: Price over VWAP + 1 standard deviation
indicators.text: Holding over the first VWAP band: a trend day reading.

indicators.label: +DI above -DI
indicators.text: Upward movement is stronger than downward movement.

indicators.label: Pullback to VWAP that holds
indicators.text: Price dipped to within 0.3 ATR of VWAP in the last 3 bars, closed back above it, and VWAP is rising: buyers defend the day average.

indicators.label: EMA 21 rising
indicators.text: The 21-bar average is higher than 3 bars ago.

indicators.label: Price 0.5 ATR or more above VWAP
indicators.text: Clear of the day average: the move has room, though it may be stretched.

indicators.label: Bounce off the lower Bollinger band
indicators.text: Price dipped under the lower band and closed back over it.

indicators.label: After 10:00
indicators.text: Skips the opening noise.

indicators.label: Heavy buying bar
indicators.text: A bullish bar on 1.5 times the usual volume.

indicators.label: Price crosses up through VWAP
indicators.text: A fresh move over the day average price.

indicators.label: Three higher closes in a row
indicators.text: Steady buying.

indicators.label: Price above VWAP
indicators.text: Over the volume-weighted average of the day: buyers hold the day.

indicators.label: Afternoon (13:30 to 15:00)
indicators.text: Positions are built for the close.

indicators.label: RSI (14) above 50
indicators.text: Buying pressure leads.

indicators.label: RSI crosses up through 50
indicators.text: Momentum turns up.

indicators.label: Not midday (skips 11:30 to 13:30)
indicators.text: Real-price tests found the midday lull wins least often. Use it as a filter beside an entry check.

indicators.label: Stochastic %K above 50
indicators.text: Price is in the upper half of its 14-bar range.

indicators.label: Pushed 1.5 ATR in 6 bars
indicators.text: A fast move up.

indicators.label: Midday (11:30 to 13:30)
indicators.text: The usual lull: moves are smaller and break less often.

indicators.label: Price above Hull average 21
indicators.text: The Hull average reacts faster than the others; price is above it.

indicators.label: RSI (2) under 10
indicators.text: A very short-term oversold reading. On its own it fights the move; pair it with a trend check.

indicators.label: EMA 5 above EMA 13
indicators.text: A quick pair of averages: the very short trend is up.

indicators.label: Breadth improving
indicators.text: The share of stocks on this side is 5 points higher than 3 bars ago.

indicators.label: Chaikin money flow above 0.1
indicators.text: Clear accumulation.

indicators.label: RSI (14) between 50 and 70
indicators.text: Strong but not stretched.

indicators.label: CCI crosses up through -100
indicators.text: Bounce from an oversold reading.

indicators.label: Narrow bar, then a wide bullish bar
indicators.text: The previous bar was the narrowest of the last 7, and this bar is wider and closes up over its high: quiet turns to movement.

indicators.label: Above VWAP but within 0.5 ATR of it
indicators.text: Over the day average and not stretched away from it: a calmer entry than a chase.

indicators.label: Parabolic SAR below price
indicators.text: The trailing dot sits under the price.

indicators.label: Price up over 10 bars
indicators.text: The close is above the close 10 bars ago.

indicators.label: Price above EMA 20
indicators.text: The last close is above its 20-bar average.

indicators.label: Full-bodied bullish bar
indicators.text: A bullish bar with almost no wicks (body over 80% of the range).

indicators.label: Williams %R above -50
indicators.text: Price is in the upper half of its 14-bar range.

indicators.label: MACD above its signal line
indicators.text: MACD line over its 9-bar average.

indicators.label: MACD crosses above its signal
indicators.text: A fresh upward cross.

indicators.label: Money flow index above 50
indicators.text: Volume-weighted RSI shows more buying than selling.

indicators.label: Money flow index crosses up through 50
indicators.text: The volume-weighted RSI turns to buying.

indicators.label: EMA 9 rising
indicators.text: The 9-bar average is higher than 2 bars ago.

indicators.label: Heikin-Ashi: two strong green bars
indicators.text: The last two Heikin-Ashi candles are green with no lower wick: a smooth push up.

indicators.label: MACD histogram positive and rising
indicators.text: Momentum is up and growing.

indicators.label: Volume 1.5 times the usual
indicators.text: Traded value is 1.5 times the average of the last 20 bars. No direction by itself.

indicators.label: Chaikin money flow above 0
indicators.text: Bars close nearer their highs on volume.

indicators.label: OBV above its 20-bar average
indicators.text: On-balance volume trends up.

indicators.label: Volume 2.5 times the usual
indicators.text: A surge in traded value. No direction by itself.

indicators.label: Awesome oscillator turns up
indicators.text: It rises after two falling bars.

indicators.label: CCI (20) above 0
indicators.text: Price is over its typical level.

indicators.label: Hammer
indicators.text: A long lower wick (twice the body, over half the range) and a close in the top third.

indicators.label: Big bullish bar
indicators.text: A bar of 1.2 ATR or more that closes in its top third.

indicators.label: RSI (7) above 55
indicators.text: A quicker RSI shows buying pressure.

indicators.label: Pullback on fading volume
indicators.text: Price is lower than 3 bars ago but volume is under average: sellers are not pushing.

indicators.label: Vortex +VI above -VI
indicators.text: Upward vortex movement dominates.

indicators.label: Ultimate oscillator above 50
indicators.text: Momentum over three time frames is positive.

indicators.label: Price above SMA 20
indicators.text: The last close is above the simple 20-bar average.

indicators.label: Price above the Bollinger middle
indicators.text: Over the 20-bar average, inside the bands.

indicators.label: Price crosses up through the Bollinger middle
indicators.text: A fresh move over the average.

indicators.label: Market is trending (choppiness under 50)
indicators.text: The choppiness index over 14 bars is under 50: price is travelling, not wandering. No direction by itself.

indicators.label: MACD histogram turns up
indicators.text: The histogram stops falling and rises while it is still below zero.

indicators.label: Force index above 0
indicators.text: Price change times volume is positive.

indicators.label: Higher highs and higher lows
indicators.text: The last 3 bars have a higher high and a higher low than the 3 before.

indicators.label: Ichimoku fast line above slow line
indicators.text: The 9-bar midpoint is above the 26-bar midpoint.

indicators.label: Above the day's average price
indicators.text: Price is above the average close of today so far.

indicators.label: Bollinger %B between 0.5 and 1
indicators.text: In the upper half of the bands but not beyond the upper band.

indicators.label: Heikin-Ashi turns green
indicators.text: The first green Heikin-Ashi candle after two red ones.

indicators.label: Stochastic %K above %D
indicators.text: The fast line is over the slow line.

indicators.label: Stochastic turns up from below 20
indicators.text: %K crosses over %D while still under 20.

indicators.label: Bullish engulfing
indicators.text: A bullish body that covers the previous bearish one.

indicators.label: Closes in the top third
indicators.text: Buyers won the bar.

indicators.label: Higher low formed
indicators.text: The last bar low is above the low of the 5 bars before.

indicators.label: Close above the previous high
indicators.text: The bar closes over the previous bar high.

indicators.label: Bar closes up
indicators.text: The close is above the open.

indicators.label: RSI (14) rising
indicators.text: RSI is higher than 3 bars ago.

indicators.label: Williams %R crosses up through -80
indicators.text: Leaves the oversold zone.

indicators.label: Today's CPR above yesterday's
indicators.text: The whole of today's CPR sits over yesterday's: value is moving up (an ascending CPR).

indicators.label: Room left in the day (range under 80% of usual)
indicators.text: Today's range so far is under 80% of the average of the last 5 days: the move is not used up yet. No direction by itself.

indicators.label: Narrow CPR day
indicators.text: Today's CPR is under 60% of its average width over the last 5 days. Indian traders read a narrow CPR as a likely trending day. No direction by itself.

indicators.label: Wide CPR day
indicators.text: Today's CPR is over 1.5 times its 5-day average width: usually a sideways day, better for fades than breakouts. No direction by itself.

indicators.label: Opened inside yesterday's range
indicators.text: Today opened between yesterday's high and low: no gap, so levels matter more. No direction by itself.

indicators.label: Gapped up at the open (0.3%+)
indicators.text: The day opened at least 0.3% over yesterday close.

indicators.label: Back into value (80% rule)
indicators.text: The day opened under yesterday's value area (where it spent 70% of its time) and then closes back inside it twice in a row: price often travels across the whole area. Stop under the last 6 bars.

indicators.label: Opening range breakout (30 min)
indicators.text: The first close beyond the 09:15-09:45 range after 09:45, a wider and slower cousin of the 15-minute range. Stop at the other end of the range.

indicators.label: Open drive (strong first half hour)
indicators.text: After 09:30 price is at least 2 ATR over the open and never fell more than half an ATR under it: buyers took the day from the first bar.

indicators.label: Back into value from below (80% rule)
indicators.text: The day opened under yesterday's value area and has now closed inside it twice in a row: price often crosses the whole area.

indicators.label: CPR breakout
indicators.text: The first close of the day above the central pivot range (yesterday's pivot and the mid of its high and low), on a day that opened under it. Traders watch it most on a narrow-CPR day. Stop under the last 6 bars.

indicators.label: First close above the CPR today
indicators.text: Price opened at or under the CPR and has just closed over it for the first time today.

indicators.label: Nifty 50 breadth
indicators.text: At least 70% of the 50 stocks are above (call) or below (put) yesterday close and the index is on the same side of its day average. Stop under the last 6 bars.

indicators.label: Gap-and-go bar
indicators.text: A bar opening over the previous high and closing higher.

indicators.label: Opening range breakout
indicators.text: The first close beyond the 09:15-09:30 range after 09:30. Stop at the other end of that range.

indicators.label: Yesterday's high / low break
indicators.text: The first 5-minute close of the day beyond the previous day's high (call) or low (put), after 09:30. Stop under the last 6 bars.

indicators.label: First close above R1 today
indicators.text: Price breaks the first resistance, 2 x pivot - yesterday's low: a strong day.

indicators.label: Breaks the Camarilla H4
indicators.text: First close of the day over H4 (yesterday's close + 1.1 x range / 2): Camarilla traders treat it as a breakout and a possible trend day.

indicators.label: Camarilla H4 / L4 breakout
indicators.text: The first close of the day beyond the Camarilla H4 (call) or L4 (put), yesterday's close plus half of its range times 1.1: often the start of a trend day. Stop under H3 or the last 6 bars, whichever is nearer.

indicators.label: Camarilla L3 / H3 reversal
indicators.text: On a day that opened inside H3 and L3, price dips under L3 and a bullish bar closes back over it (for a put: pokes over H3 and closes back under). A range-day fade. Stop under the last 6 bars.

indicators.label: Double bottom / top
indicators.text: Price makes the same low twice, with a bounce of at least 1.5 ATR between them, then closes above the bounce high. Stop under the two lows.

indicators.label: Double bottom / top, tighter stop
indicators.text: The same double bottom, but the stop sits half way between the lows and the neckline, so it fits the loss limit. It gives up the room under the lows.

indicators.label: Nifty 50 breadth 80%+
indicators.text: At least 80% of the 50 stocks agree: a one-way day.

indicators.label: Reclaims the Camarilla L3
indicators.text: On a day that opened inside H3 and L3, price closes back over L3 after being under it: the range-day fade.

indicators.label: Three advancing bars
indicators.text: Three bullish bars, each closing higher with a real body.

indicators.label: VWAP reclaim / rejection
indicators.text: Price closed under the volume-weighted average for 3 bars, then closes back above it on 1.2 times the usual volume. Stop under the last 6 bars. The index has no volume of its own, so VWAP and volume are built from the traded value of the 50 stocks.

indicators.label: RSI (14) under 75
indicators.text: Not yet overbought: some room left. For a put, RSI over 25.

indicators.label: Price above R1
indicators.text: Trading over the first floor resistance.

indicators.label: Inside bar breakout
indicators.text: A big bar (1.2 ATR or more), a small bar inside it, then a close beyond the big bar. Stop at the big bar other end.

indicators.label: Quiet bars, then a break on volume
indicators.text: Three bars on below-average volume, then a close over the 6-bar high on 1.5 times the usual volume: a coil that opens with money behind it.

indicators.label: Price above the CPR
indicators.text: The close is over the whole central pivot range (the pivot and the middle of yesterday's high and low).

indicators.label: EMA 21 above EMA 50
indicators.text: The medium trend is up.

indicators.label: Above yesterday's value area
indicators.text: Price is over the top of where yesterday spent 70% of its time (market profile, by time at price): buyers accept higher prices.

indicators.label: Volume climax at a low / high
indicators.text: A bar at the 20-bar low on 2.5 times the usual volume that closes in its top half: sellers look exhausted. Stop under the bar.

indicators.label: Above yesterday's busiest price
indicators.text: Price is over yesterday's point of control, the price it spent most time at.

indicators.label: Price above EMA 200
indicators.text: Above the long-run average (about 2.5 sessions of 5-minute bars).

indicators.label: Breaks yesterday's high
indicators.text: The close crosses over the whole of yesterday for the first time today.

indicators.label: Above yesterday's high
indicators.text: Price is trading over the whole of yesterday.

indicators.label: Pullback to the pivot that holds
indicators.text: Price dipped to within 0.3 ATR of the pivot (or the CPR top) in the last 3 bars and a bullish bar closes back over it.

indicators.label: Price above today's pivot
indicators.text: The close is over the floor pivot, (yesterday's high + low + close) / 3: the day leans to buyers.

indicators.label: Nifty 50 breadth 70%+
indicators.text: At least 70% of the 50 stocks agree.

indicators.label: Supertrend flip
indicators.text: The supertrend (10, 3) turns from down to up. Stop at the supertrend line.

indicators.label: Supertrend (14, 3) up
indicators.text: A slower supertrend is below price: fewer flips on a choppy day.

indicators.label: Strong momentum bar
indicators.text: A big bar (1.5 ATR or more) that closes in its top 15% and above the highest high of the last 6 bars. Stop under the bar.

indicators.label: Supertrend (10, 3) up
indicators.text: The supertrend line is below price.

indicators.label: Nifty 50 breadth 60%+
indicators.text: At least 60% of the 50 stocks are above yesterday close (for a put: below).

indicators.label: Above yesterday's close
indicators.text: The day is up.

indicators.label: TRIX above zero
indicators.text: The triple-smoothed rate of change is positive.

indicators.label: Bollinger squeeze, then a close above the upper band
indicators.text: The bands were the narrowest of the last 50 bars within the last 6 bars, and price now closes over the upper band.

indicators.label: ATR not wild (under 1.5 times its 50-bar average)
indicators.text: Bars are not unusually big: stops are less likely to be hit by noise. No direction by itself.

indicators.label: Near the day's high
indicators.text: Within 0.3 ATR of the day's high.

indicators.label: Above the opening range
indicators.text: Price is above the high of the first 15 minutes (after 09:30).

indicators.label: Breaks the opening range (first 15 minutes)
indicators.text: The close crosses over the high of the first three bars for the first time.

indicators.label: ADX over 25 and rising, buyers lead
indicators.text: A strong trend that is still getting stronger, with +DI over -DI.

indicators.label: Breadth crosses to the majority
indicators.text: More than half of the 50 stocks switch to this side.

indicators.label: 55-bar high broken (about 4.5 hours)
indicators.text: The close beats the highest high of the 55 bars before: the turtle-style breakout.

indicators.label: ATR above its 50-bar average
indicators.text: Bars are bigger than usual: the market is moving. No direction by itself.

indicators.label: Engulfing candle at a low / high
indicators.text: After a few falling bars near the 20-bar low, a bullish candle whose body covers the previous bearish one. Stop under both.

indicators.label: Squeeze fires up (Bollinger leaves Keltner)
indicators.text: The Bollinger bands were inside the Keltner channel (a coiled market) and have just opened with price above the middle.

indicators.label: EMA 9 > 21 > 50 lined up
indicators.text: All three averages are lined up upward: a clean trend.

indicators.label: Above the 2-day anchored VWAP
indicators.text: Price is over the VWAP anchored at yesterday's open: buyers of the last two days are in profit.

indicators.label: ADX over 30 and +DI over -DI
indicators.text: A strong trend that buyers lead.

indicators.label: Breakout on high volume
indicators.text: The breakout of the last hour, on at least 1.5 times the usual volume (traded value of the 50 stocks). Stop under the last 6 bars.

indicators.label: Above the day's open
indicators.text: Price is above where the day opened.

indicators.label: 15-minute trend up
indicators.text: The 15-minute averages (EMA 27 over EMA 63 on 5-minute bars) agree: the bigger picture is up, so a pullback is a gift and not a warning.

indicators.label: Hammer / shooting star
indicators.text: A candle near the 20-bar low with a long lower wick (twice its body, over half the range) that closes in its top third. Stop under the wick.

indicators.label: VWAP pullback in a trend
indicators.text: The index has held above a rising VWAP (8 of the last 12 bars), dips to touch it and closes above the previous bar high. Stop under the dip.

indicators.label: Pullback in a trend
indicators.text: The 9, 21 and 50 EMAs are lined up, price dips to the 21 EMA and then closes above the previous bar high. Stop under the dip.

indicators.label: RSI crosses up through 30
indicators.text: The oversold bounce.

indicators.label: Sharp fall, then turn
indicators.text: A fall of 4 ATR or more, then price turns off the low: a higher low and a bar that closes above the previous bar high, within 2 ATR of the low. Stop under the low.

indicators.label: EMA 50 rising
indicators.text: The 50-bar average is higher than 5 bars ago.

indicators.label: RSI (2) dip bought in an uptrend
indicators.text: Connors style: the 2-bar RSI was under 10 and turns back over it while price is over the 50 EMA. A short dip in a rising market.

indicators.label: MACD above zero
indicators.text: The 12 EMA is over the 26 EMA.

indicators.label: ADX rising (trend getting stronger)
indicators.text: ADX is over 18 and higher than 3 bars ago, with buyers leading: a trend is building, not fading.

indicators.label: Price above the Ichimoku cloud
indicators.text: Price is above both cloud edges.

indicators.label: ADX over 25 (strong trend)
indicators.text: A strong trend is under way, either way. It does not pick a direction, so pair it with another check.

indicators.label: ATR expanding
indicators.text: Ranges are 10% wider than 10 bars ago: the market is waking up. No direction by itself.

indicators.label: Morning (09:30 to 11:30)
indicators.text: The most active hours.

indicators.label: First hour after the open (09:30 to 10:30)
indicators.text: The hour most big one-way days are decided.

indicators.label: +DI crosses over -DI (ADX over 20)
indicators.text: Buyers take over the directional movement while a trend exists.

indicators.label: Inside the Camarilla H3 to L3
indicators.text: Price is between H3 and L3: a balanced, range-bound reading. No direction by itself.

indicators.label: Close above the upper Bollinger band
indicators.text: A push beyond two standard deviations.

indicators.label: 20-bar high broken
indicators.text: The close is above the highest high of the 20 bars before.

indicators.label: Rising straight-line trend (20 bars)
indicators.text: The best-fit line through 20 bars slopes up and fits well (R squared over 0.6).

indicators.label: EMA 9 / 21 cross
indicators.text: The 9 EMA crosses above the 21 EMA with price above both. Stop under the last 6 bars.

indicators.label: EMA 9 above EMA 21
indicators.text: The 9-bar average is above the 21-bar average: the short trend is up.

indicators.label: Close above the upper Keltner channel
indicators.text: A push beyond 1.5 ATR over the 20 EMA.

indicators.label: Aroon up over 70
indicators.text: The high of the last 25 bars is recent and the low is old.

indicators.label: RSI (14) above 60
indicators.text: Clear buying pressure, a step stronger than above 50.

indicators.label: Price above SMA 50
indicators.text: The last close is above the simple 50-bar average.

indicators.label: MACD above its signal and above zero
indicators.text: Momentum is up on both counts: the line leads its signal and the 12 EMA is over the 26 EMA.

indicators.label: ADX over 20 and +DI over -DI
indicators.text: A trend exists (ADX over 20) and buyers lead it.

indicators.label: Price above EMA 50
indicators.text: The last close is above its 50-bar average.

indicators.label: Breakout of the last hour
indicators.text: A 5-minute bar closes above the highest high of the last hour (12 bars). Stop under the lowest low of the last 6 bars.

indicators.label: CCI (20) above 100
indicators.text: Unusually strong.

indicators.label: Back inside from under VWAP - 2 standard deviations
indicators.text: Price was under the lower 2-deviation band and closes back over it: a stretched fall snapping back.

indicators.label: Aroon up above Aroon down
indicators.text: The latest high is newer than the latest low.

indicators.label: Awesome oscillator above 0
indicators.text: 5-bar midpoint average over the 34-bar one.

indicators.label: Supertrend (7, 2) up

indicators.label: Bollinger squeeze (tight bands)
indicators.text: The bands are as narrow as at any time in the last 50 bars: a big move is brewing, either way.

indicators.label: VWAP rising
indicators.text: The day average is higher than 3 bars ago.

indicators.label: Price over VWAP + 1 standard deviation
indicators.text: Holding over the first VWAP band: a trend day reading.

indicators.label: +DI above -DI
indicators.text: Upward movement is stronger than downward movement.

indicators.label: Pullback to VWAP that holds
indicators.text: Price dipped to within 0.3 ATR of VWAP in the last 3 bars, closed back above it, and VWAP is rising: buyers defend the day average.

indicators.label: EMA 21 rising
indicators.text: The 21-bar average is higher than 3 bars ago.

indicators.label: Price 0.5 ATR or more above VWAP
indicators.text: Clear of the day average: the move has room, though it may be stretched.

indicators.label: Bounce off the lower Bollinger band
indicators.text: Price dipped under the lower band and closed back over it.

indicators.label: After 10:00
indicators.text: Skips the opening noise.

indicators.label: Heavy buying bar
indicators.text: A bullish bar on 1.5 times the usual volume.

indicators.label: Price crosses up through VWAP
indicators.text: A fresh move over the day average price.

indicators.label: Three higher closes in a row
indicators.text: Steady buying.

indicators.label: Price above VWAP
indicators.text: Over the volume-weighted average of the day: buyers hold the day.

indicators.label: Afternoon (13:30 to 15:00)
indicators.text: Positions are built for the close.

indicators.label: RSI (14) above 50
indicators.text: Buying pressure leads.

indicators.label: RSI crosses up through 50
indicators.text: Momentum turns up.

indicators.label: Not midday (skips 11:30 to 13:30)
indicators.text: Real-price tests found the midday lull wins least often. Use it as a filter beside an entry check.

indicators.label: Stochastic %K above 50
indicators.text: Price is in the upper half of its 14-bar range.

indicators.label: Pushed 1.5 ATR in 6 bars
indicators.text: A fast move up.

indicators.label: Midday (11:30 to 13:30)
indicators.text: The usual lull: moves are smaller and break less often.

indicators.label: Price above Hull average 21
indicators.text: The Hull average reacts faster than the others; price is above it.

indicators.label: RSI (2) under 10
indicators.text: A very short-term oversold reading. On its own it fights the move; pair it with a trend check.

indicators.label: EMA 5 above EMA 13
indicators.text: A quick pair of averages: the very short trend is up.

indicators.label: Breadth improving
indicators.text: The share of stocks on this side is 5 points higher than 3 bars ago.

indicators.label: Chaikin money flow above 0.1
indicators.text: Clear accumulation.

indicators.label: RSI (14) between 50 and 70
indicators.text: Strong but not stretched.

indicators.label: CCI crosses up through -100
indicators.text: Bounce from an oversold reading.

indicators.label: Above VWAP but within 0.5 ATR of it
indicators.text: Over the day average and not stretched away from it: a calmer entry than a chase.

indicators.label: Parabolic SAR below price
indicators.text: The trailing dot sits under the price.

indicators.label: Full-bodied bullish bar

indicators.text: The 9-bar average is higher than 2 bars ago.

indicators.label: MACD histogram positive and rising
indicators.text: Momentum is up and growing.

indicators.label: Volume 1.5 times the usual

indicators.label: Chaikin money flow above 0
indicators.text: Bars close nearer their highs on volume.

indicators.label: OBV above its 20-bar average
indicators.text: On-balance volume trends up.

indicators.label: Volume 2.5 times the usual
indicators.text: A surge in traded value. No direction by itself.

indicators.label: Awesome oscillator turns up
indicators.text: It rises after two falling bars.

indicators.label: CCI (20) above 0
indicators.text: Price is over its typical level.

indicators.label: Hammer
indicators.text: A long lower wick (twice the body, over half the range) and a close in the top third.

indicators.label: Big bullish bar
indicators.text: A bar of 1.2 ATR or more that closes in its top third.

indicators.label: RSI (7) above 55
indicators.text: A quicker RSI shows buying pressure.

indicators.label: Pullback on fading volume
indicators.text: Price is lower than 3 bars ago but volume is under average: sellers are not pushing.

indicators.label: Vortex +VI above -VI

indicators.label: Ultimate oscillator above 50
indicators.text: Momentum over three time frames is positive.

indicators.label: Price above SMA 20
indicators.text: The last close is above the simple 20-bar average.

indicators.label: Price above the Bollinger middle
indicators.text: Over the 20-bar average, inside the bands.

indicators.label: Price crosses up through the Bollinger middle
indicators.text: A fresh move over the average.

indicators.label: Market is trending (choppiness under 50)
indicators.text: The choppiness index over 14 bars is under 50: price is travelling, not wandering. No direction by itself.

indicators.label: MACD histogram turns up
indicators.text: The histogram stops falling and rises while it is still below zero.

indicators.label: Force index above 0
indicators.text: Price change times volume is positive.

indicators.label: Higher highs and higher lows
indicators.text: The last 3 bars have a higher high and a higher low than the 3 before.

indicators.label: Ichimoku fast line above slow line
indicators.text: The 9-bar midpoint is above the 26-bar midpoint.

indicators.label: Above the day's average price
indicators.text: Price is above the average close of today so far.

indicators.label: Bollinger %B between 0.5 and 1
indicators.text: In the upper half of the bands but not beyond the upper band.

indicators.label: Heikin-Ashi turns green
indicators.text: The first green Heikin-Ashi candle after two red ones.

indicators.label: Stochastic %K above %D
indicators.text: The fast line is over the slow line.

indicators.label: Stochastic turns up from below 20
indicators.text: %K crosses over %D while still under 20.

indicators.label: Bullish engulfing
indicators.text: A bullish body that covers the previous bearish one.

indicators.label: Closes in the top third
indicators.text: Buyers won the bar.

indicators.label: Higher low formed
indicators.text: The last bar low is above the low of the 5 bars before.

indicators.label: Close above the previous high
indicators.text: The bar closes over the previous bar high.

indicators.label: Bar closes up
indicators.text: The close is above the open.

indicators.label: RSI (14) rising
indicators.text: RSI is higher than 3 bars ago.
